name: Exterior Garage Door Surface Preparation
intent: Substrate-specific prep: steel wax removal + degloss, wood sand + fill + tannin spot, carriage mixed-material prep.
doctrine: Garage door prep. Steel: factory prime has wax contamination — wax removal mandatory before DTM primer. Wood: sand + fill per DASMA TDS #162. Carriage: mixed-material (steel base + composite overlays). Door size modifier applies.
